summary: Retain item spoilage acquisition and its research gates in science and laboratory progression.
details: Factorio 2.0 and 2.1 acquisition can follow positive-duration item spoilage when the engine enables spoiling. The existing solver requires an acquired perishable input and retains its actual research unlocks.

Unseeded native or mixed recipe/spoilage cycles, self-locked science, missing capability facts and same-named fluids cannot grant acquisition. Normal queries reuse the shared item index; capped diagnostics retain budgeted raw traversal.

Controlled canonical Lua tests reproduce the predecessor failure, exercise actual laboratory services and check research gates, alternative seeds, recipe-epoch invalidation and bounded diagnostics. Current-package native production, catalogue and save acceptance remain pending.
